//Heron: The event card hw_tgr_heron spawns. One popup with one button; clicking it lowers the Minnow (SpecialDurability3) and Perch (SpecialDurability2) of ONE Water-Driven Infrastructure fishpond in the current location, never Pike (SpecialDurability1), and never any other card. AppliesTo 6 = AllCardsInLocation (Documentation/Design/Harsh_Wilds_Content_Update_As_Built.md Wave 0 findings W0-3: the eagle's 5, AllCardsInBase, never reaches a placed CT2 pond). CardChanges 0 = ChangeDurabilities, so the pond card is changed and never destroyed; LookInInventories false; RandomlyAffectedCards 1 Absolute (one pond per visit). Special3Change -2 and Special2Change -1 are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS (a pond holds 10 of each, regrowing 0.005 a tick; a stocked pond starts at 4). Both numbers are fixed ranges, x equal to y. There is deliberately NO NoCardsAffectedMessage (plan 4.2: the measured second popup after a successful change), and no CustomDestroyMessage because nothing is destroyed: the player sees the card go and the pond's fish bars drop. DANGER, guarded in C#: ExtraDurabilityChange.AppliesToAllCards reads an empty resolved AffectedCards as EVERY card, which is what a list of two pond UIDs becomes when Water-Driven Infrastructure is not installed. Patcher/HeronRaidGuard.cs checks the loaded change after every load and empties ExtraDurabilityModifications unless AffectedCards is exactly the two ponds. The list is the two UIDs of hw_tgr_heron's weight rows; keep them identical (Development_Tools/Tests/HarshWilds-Heron.Tests.ps1 checks it).
